name: Imputation-based Bayesian association analysis
model_likelihood: Quantitative phenotype linear regression; additive across SNPs with additive and dominance effects per SNP; iid Gaussian residuals
prior: p0 mass on no QTNs; otherwise count p(l) and uniform SNP subsets; additive-effect prior scaled by within-genotype phenotype SD; D1 and D2 alternatives
inference_algorithm: PHASE or fastPHASE multiple imputations; D1 MCMC; D2 analytical calculations averaged across imputations
estimand: Posterior SNP-effect distributions; per-SNP QTN probabilities; regional association Bayes factor
data_input: Dense panel genotypes; cohort tag-SNP genotypes and univariate quantitative phenotypes
tunable_settings: p0; QTN-count distribution p(l); effect-size scale sigma_a; D1 versus D2; optional normal-quantile phenotype transformation
